assumptions.affected_conclusions: net revenue and incremental operating result
assumptions.sensitivity: solve maximum affordable distribution drag from actual incremental cost; sweep0/.03/.08/.15
assumptions.refinement: RW sales-channel mix, agent/acquiring rates, commissions policy and cost ledger

assumptions.value: 20kg basket includes its baggage; additional ancillary and separately paid pass-through excluded in reference scenario; cash_profileUNKNOWN
assumptions.basis: No extra baggage income added to included allowance. Airline airport/handling costs stay P04, not pass-through. Carried journeys not multiplied again by refund probability; cancellations retained fees require separate events.
assumptions.range_or_unknown: Actual extra ancillary/pass-through/cash UNKNOWN; reference exclusion is a scope choice, not actual zero
assumptions.affected_conclusions: net fare, no double refund/distribution/airport deductions; no cash forecast
assumptions.sensitivity: vary ancillary and genuine pass-through separately; no invented settlement date
assumptions.refinement: Fare tax breakdown, agent settlement, refunds/no-shows and ancillary recognized revenue

assumptions.value: same high-level passive or price_match10 policy forP andKEEP; month/cohort-specific triggers precomputed
assumptions.basis: Incumbent reaction unobserved;10%farecut is diagnostic. P06early sums frequencies across months; adapter binds rule to exact pool/month/cohort then emits activated intercept shift. No added competitor supply.
assumptions.range_or_unknown: UNKNOWN reaction policy;0/10/20%farecut diagnostic only
assumptions.affected_conclusions: competitive capture and deltas
assumptions.sensitivity: compare passive vs pricecut; scope-leak counterexample
assumptions.refinement: Dated competitor price/capacity response panel, local city research

assumptions.value: MOW airport demand aliases one city pool; all others author endpoint markets; physical airport legs unchanged
assumptions.basis: One forecast per directed endpoint pair independent of programme. Author catchment overlaps may bias prior population; no claim that regional population is uniquely assigned. No same-city airport source counts added.
assumptions.range_or_unknown: UNKNOWN own-airport substitution and disjoint catchment geometry
assumptions.affected_conclusions: sharedpool conservation, MOW demand and own migration
assumptions.sensitivity: reuse same pool across all alternatives; do not duplicateMOW forZIA
assumptions.refinement: Geocoded catchment/trip origins, airport-choice survey and nonoverlap partition

assumptions.value: grouped leave-origin-out OLS only for annual airport segment proxy; exclude partial-year, regional and airline-subset rows
assumptions.basis: Retained observations have same reported annual airport segment unit. These historical sources are inherited secondary extracts. Segment proxy prediction cannot validate endpointOD, monthly seasons or behaviour.
assumptions.range_or_unknown: External primary endpointOD holdout UNKNOWN
assumptions.affected_conclusions: validation/calibration status
assumptions.sensitivity: report every heldout prediction incl failures; no train reuse as empiricalholdout
assumptions.refinement: New independent compatible endpointOD observations outside fitting group

assumptions.value: unconstrained share and revenue thresholds; actual full operating costs not supplied toP05
assumptions.basis: Threshold computations use conservation/choice algebra. Endogenous price-demand response recomputed. Cost threshold remains symbolic until P04programme drivers, alternative use and KEEP scope accepted.
assumptions.range_or_unknown: UNKNOWN actual breakeven cost; no profitability assertion
assumptions.affected_conclusions: price, demand and commission decision thresholds
assumptions.sensitivity: break-evenRUB=carried*netfare; affordability condition explicit
assumptions.refinement: Full incremental programme costs and jointly recomputedKEEP
